items.html: Also, it seems to me that I heard from my teacher, may his memory be blessed, another answer to this, namely: this matter is said only when each and every degree is in its proper place, for then the measure of the lowest degree in the upper world is greater than everything below it. But when the world of Beriah ascends to the world of Atzilut, then Beriah returns to being in the degree of Atzilut itself, and it needs as much measure of place as if it itself were Atzilut. And likewise, in a similar manner, in the rest of the worlds. Therefore, when Yetzirah ascended to the place of the Nukva of Atzilut, it returned to being in its value, and the four first Sefirot of Yetzirah need as much measure of place as the female of Atzilut, whose measure is also four Sefirot of Atzilut, as above.
